name: Vespid Dynamics Pheromone Trail Marker PTM-2
product_name: Vespid Dynamics Pheromone Trail Marker PTM-2
description: A wrist-mounted dispenser that releases invisible synthetic pheromone compounds to mark a path, location, or target. The PTM-2 uses Vespid's pheromone library to create markers detectable only by specialized sensors or Vespid drone platforms, creating invisible trails that can be followed hours or days after being laid. Different pheromone compounds encode different meanings — danger, safe passage, target location, rally point — allowing the creation of an invisible information layer overlaid on the physical environment. The markers persist on surfaces for 48-72 hours depending on weather conditions.

specifications.detection: Vespid drone platforms or specialized sensor
specifications.range: Contact application — spray on surface from 30 cm

story_hooks: A pheromone trail was discovered leading from a secure facility's emergency exit to a waiting vehicle location — someone marked the escape route in advance using PTM-2 compounds.
Vespid's drones have been following PTM-2 trails that were not laid by authorized operators — someone has obtained the pheromone compounds and is manipulating Vespid's own drone networks.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek wrist-mounted dispenser resembling a tactical smartwatch crossed with a perfume atomizer. Compact, angular chassis with a prominent spray nozzle extending from the inner wrist edge. The device curves to fit snugly against the forearm, with a minimalist control surface dominating the top face.
physical_description.dimensions: 12 cm long × 4.5 cm wide × 2.8 cm tall (wrist-mounted orientation)
physical_description.weight_description: Extremely light (80g) — barely noticeable when worn; pocketable if removed
physical_description.primary_material: Brushed titanium-aluminum composite body with injection-molded polymer grip panels
physical_description.finish: Matte gunmetal with oil-slick iridescent accents on the spray mechanism; anti-fingerprint coating
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal gray primary with acid-green accent trim around the nozzle and control interface; faint bioluminescent blue charging indicators
physical_description.interface_elements: Three pressure-touch buttons (compound selection, spray trigger, status), a micro-OLED readout displaying compound type and cartridge capacity as percentages, USB-C charging port recessed into the wrist band, haptic feedback motor for silent confirmations
distinctive_features: Precision spray nozzle with adjustable mist pattern (visible as a rotating collar with micro-engravings)
Translucent polymer cartridge window showing remaining pheromone compound as colored liquid
Integrated gyroscopic stabilizer visible as a faint shimmer under the housing
Vespid-signature asymmetrical design mimicking insect anatomy
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: VESPID DYNAMICS logo (stylized wasp head in chrome) on upper face; PTM-2 model designation laser-etched along the side; regulatory hologram (glints when tilted) near charging port
physical_description.condition_typical: In use: worn loose on the wrist with spray nozzle angled downward; cartridge window slightly cloudy with residual compound vapor; control buttons show light wear from frequent use
